description:
docs/reactor-scoping/bwr.md:64-65 lists crates/bedok under the '### HAVE' table (3-D two-group nodal diffusion coupled to channel TH; committed NEACRP D1 benchmark case). But the same document at :94, under '### SCAFFOLD — do not count as working', states: 'crates/bedok has never been run against its benchmark. Every benchmark gate is ignored, no parity run has been done, and its README makes no parity claim.'

Both statements cannot be true. The SCAFFOLD entry is the accurate one (verified 2026-08-07): the 3-D nodal path panics at todo!() — see the companion bead on seam.rs. Fix bwr.md so bedok appears once, in the honest column, or annotate the HAVE row explicitly as 'code present, never executed'.

Verified 2026-08-07 by reading the working tree.
title: bedok: bwr.md contradicts itself — bedok listed under HAVE and under SCAFFOLD

description:
The HTR-10 simulator's piping and secondary-loop geometry are INVENTED PLACEHOLDERS, by maintainer's decision 2026-08-12: 'for now, let's just invent placeholders'. This bead is to replace them with sourced figures later.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY HAVE, from IAEA-TECDOC-1382 (ingested at crates/kovan-literature/generated/markdown/open/iaea-tecdoc-1382-part1.md and part2, PDFs alongside in crates/kovan-literature/open/reports/):

  primary helium      3.0 MPa, 250 degC in / 700 degC out, 4.3 kg/s, 10 MWth
  main steam          440 degC at 4.0 MPa, 12.5 t/hr
  feedwater           104 degC
  steam generator     once-through modular HELICAL tube type, in a SEPARATE
                      vessel 11.3 m tall x 2.5 m ID, ~70 t, with the helium
                      circulator mounted ABOVE the SG in that same vessel
  hot gas duct        900 mm opening in the RPV wall joining the two vessels
  RPV                 4.2 m ID x 11.1 m, ~142 t

WHAT IS MISSING, and therefore invented in the simulator:

  - SG tube diameter, wall thickness, coil pitch, number of tube modules
  - hot gas duct inner/outer diameter and the coaxial arrangement
  - primary loop pipe sizes and lengths
  - the turbine/condenser side beyond the steam conditions above
  - feedwater pump and any secondary pressure drops

WHY IT IS MISSING: TECDOC-1382 is a NEUTRONICS BENCHMARK. Its detail is core
physics — criticality, control-rod worths, temperature coefficients — so it
carries almost no plant piping. This is a limitation of the source, not of the
ingestion.

WHERE TO LOOK NEXT:
  - crates/kovan-literature/generated/markdown/open/vhtr-modul-safety-jrc.md
    (JRC VHTR-MODUL safety report, also newly ingested) may carry more
    plant-side engineering than a neutronics benchmark does.
  - The Wu, Lin & Zhong HTR-10 design-features paper in Nuclear Engineering and
    Design (~2002) is the standard open source for the plant arrangement — see
    docs/reactor-scoping/htr10.md, which lists it at high confidence.
  - reference-data/virtual_test_bed/htgr/htr10/ is neutronics only and has NO
    thermal hydraulics (recorded in docs/reactor-scoping/vtb-findings.md), so
    it will not supply this.

ACCEPTANCE: every invented dimension either replaced by a sourced figure with
its citation, or explicitly marked in the module docs as illustrative and not
from any specific design. Do NOT leave an invented number looking sourced —
that is the failure mode RESPONSIBLE_USE.md exists to prevent.
title: htgr_sim_v1: replace invented piping and secondary-loop geometry with sourced HTR-10 values
